steps.command: iptables -A OUTPUT -d {dst_ip} -j DROP && iptables -A INPUT -s {dst_ip} -j DROP
steps.description: Sever the C2 communication channel. This is the highest priority action.

steps.action: Block C2 IP at perimeter firewall
steps.command: iptables -I FORWARD 1 -s {dst_ip} -j DROP && iptables -I FORWARD 1 -d {dst_ip} -j DROP
steps.description: Block C2 destination at the network perimeter to prevent re-establishment.
Identify the specific process maintaining the C2 channel.
Extract indicators of compromise from the malicious process memory.
Capture traffic to characterize beacon interval, encoding, and commands received.
Find how the implant maintains persistence across reboots.

steps.action: Kill malicious process and remove persistence
steps.description: Terminate the implant and remove all identified persistence mechanisms.

steps.action: Search for lateral movement indicators on all internal hosts
steps.command: for ip in $(arp -n | awk '{print $1}'); do nmap -p 445,22,3389 $ip; done
steps.description: The presence of C2 implies active compromise — hunt for pivot activity on all hosts.

steps.action: File IR report with MITRE T1071.001 + IOC bundle
steps.command: echo 'C2 INCIDENT: T1071.001 | c2_ip={dst_ip} | pid={pid} | interval={beacon_interval}s | time={timestamp}' >> /var/log/intelli-soc/incidents.log
steps.description: Include beacon interval, C2 IP, process name, and all extracted IOCs.
